uc-1.1.summary: Phase 1 (Stop the growth). The raw-style test with today's counts. See UC3.1, UC3.2, UC3.3; §D4.
acceptance: The test passes on today's views; it fails on a planted extra `className` in a listed view, on any raw style in a new view, and on a listed file whose count is zero.

uc-1.2.summary: Phase 1 (Stop the growth). The class check runs in CI against Kiro Crew's own stylesheet. See UC4; §D5.
acceptance: The test fails on a planted class Kiro Crew's stylesheet lacks and names the file that uses it; a stylesheet with the wrong digest is refused; the CI classifier selects the test for a change under `kirocrew-app/ui/src`; every class it finds missing today is listed in the pull request with its files.

uc-2.1.summary: Phase 2 (The parts that remove the most strings). `Hint`, `ErrorText`, `Stack`, `Row` and `TextLink`. See UC2.1, UC2.3, UC2.4; §D2.
acceptance: The five render tests pass; the raw-style count across views drops by at least 600; the page tests pass with assertions unchanged; screenshots go to the owner.

uc-2.2.summary: Phase 2 (The parts that remove the most strings). Move the shared parts into `src/ui/`. See UC1.2, UC2.2; §D1.
acceptance: No view imports `@kirocrew/app-sdk/ui` directly, checked by a source test; the page renders the same, checked by the existing page tests with assertions unchanged.

uc-3.1.summary: Phase 3 (Kiro Crew's parts). `Select` and `Toggle` for the raw controls. See UC1.1, UC1.4; §D3.
acceptance: No view renders a raw `<select>` or checkbox; each moved control keeps its label, its `aria-describedby` and its keyboard behavior, checked by test; differences found are listed in the pull request; screenshots go to the owner.

uc-3.2.summary: Phase 3 (Kiro Crew's parts). `Modal`. See UC1.1, UC1.3; §D3.
acceptance: The modal tests pass with assertions unchanged, or each changed one is listed with the reason; screenshots of three dialogs go to the owner.

uc-3.3.summary: Phase 3 (Kiro Crew's parts). `InfoTip`, `PageHeader`, `CardTitle`, `StatCard` and `ErrorNotice`. See UC1.1, UC1.3, UC1.4; §D3.
acceptance: The tooltip and heading tests pass with assertions unchanged, or each changed one is listed; Home's tiles use `StatCard`; screenshots go to the owner.

uc-3.4.summary: Phase 3 (Kiro Crew's parts). `MarkdownRenderer`. See UC1.1, UC1.3; §D3.
acceptance: The markdown tests pass with assertions unchanged, or each changed one is listed; screenshots of a spec page and a task drawer go to the owner.

uc-4.1.summary: Phase 4 (Settings and the rest of the views). Settings onto `Field` and `FieldGroup`. See UC2.1, UC2.2; §D2.
acceptance: The settings tests pass with assertions unchanged; no Settings view is left in the allow-list; screenshots of every Settings page go to the owner.

uc-4.2.summary: Phase 4 (Settings and the rest of the views). The remaining views. See UC3, UC5; §D6.
acceptance: The allow-list is empty; no view writes a `className`, `style`, `<style>` or `var(--`; the class check passes; screenshots of every view at 390 and 1280 px, light and dark, go to the owner.

uc-p1.summary: Phase 4 (Settings and the rest of the views). Proof: a change of look is one edit. See UC1 to UC5; §D1.
acceptance: Expected: (1) every hint on every view changes, and no view file changed; (2) the check fails naming only files in `src/ui/`; (3) every such file is in `src/ui/`.
Expected result observed; receipt under `docs/evidence/`, with no image committed.
